meta.badge: Precomputed results · evaluated in batches of 512 cars
meta.utility_note: Errors are Cartesian meters on the full 1,505,756-sample test set, evaluated in random batches of 512 cars.
sources: All numbers: one car at a time (each car encoded with only its own neighbours), verified against true single-car runs to within 0.09 ft.
Attack: the original MLP attacker recipe and seed, retrained on one-car representations of each encoder and tested on the 236,914-sample attack test split. Majority guess (always I-80) is 53.4%.
Trajectory error: Cartesian RMSE, ADE and FDE in meters on the full 1,505,756-sample NGSIM test set. TAPPFL uses the round-8 retrained decoder.
Raw-history probe: the same MLP on the ego car's raw 3 s (x, y) history, no model: 74.9%.
Training curves: W&B runs 9gtyuhc3 (FL), fwitybpv (TAPPFL), pjyj9gkr (decoder retrain).
Scenes: 36 NGSIM test cars, 12 per maneuver (6 per highway), seed 12; lane changes move at least 2.5 m sideways. Challenging = top 5% final error among lane changes.

scatter_note: Only two settings have both measurements. No other λ value has been evaluated for both utility and leakage.
grid_note: Majority guess means always answering I-80. In one fixed random draw of 100 test cars the attacker got 72 (FL) and 67 (TAPPFL) right, so single batches of 100 swing by several cars.
training_summary: Training loss per client, recorded live in W&B
training_empty: Per-round curves (utility loss, privacy loss, adversary accuracy) will be pulled from the run logs.

fl.name: Full 12 round run
fl.note: W&B run 9gtyuhc3 (battraj-federated-no-behavior), 12 rounds × 10 clients. Clients train one after another within each round, so each client's line has gaps while the others train.

tappfl.name: polar-fog-9
tappfl.note: W&B run fwitybpv (tappfl-battraj), 12 rounds × 10 clients. Client loss is the total TAPPFL loss (utility + λ·privacy), which goes below zero because the privacy term is negative.
